Comment.value: Concerning Pipeweed strain (roadmap: concerning-pipeweed). Smoked at the water pipes of the Smoking Chamber; all effect comes from wg_bong.nss / pw_inc.nss, so it deliberately carries no item properties.

value.0:
Bree-grown leaf out of the fields on the south side of the hill, and a little disreputable for it -- the Shire will tell you no Bree-land soil ever grew a decent pipe-weed. The Shire is not entirely honest about how much of it it buys.

Smoked in a water pipe of the Smoking Chamber, the tongue runs free and the judgement runs after it.

Charisma +4, Wisdom -4, Persuade +10, for one hour of real time. Resting will not clear it.
